Context: 3. Certain Special Entries.-

## 3. Certain Special Entries.-  
- (i) Suspension.Period of every suspension and other interruption of service should be entered with full details of its duration, reference to Order, etc. Entry should be made across the page and duly attested.SR 200.  
- (ii) Reduction to a lower post.Reason for reduction should be briefly recorded. - SR 201.
